speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Given your 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain, I need to check your blood counts immediately. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and platelet count.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

The combination of fever, easy bruising (thrombocytopenia), fatigue (anemia), severe leg pain (likely bone marrow expansion), and a markedly elevated white blood cell count with low platelets strongly suggests ALL. I recommend requesting an urgent bone marrow biopsy and imaging studies to confirm the diagnosis and stage the disease.
